messages:
Ana Rivera: Planning thread \ . CloudScale wants Redwood landing, marketplace listing, and joint blog to publish simultaneously. Ops preferred window?
Mike Chen: Ops suggests 09:00-10:30 UTC (short window to limit blast radius). @Priya ok?
Priya (CloudScale): Yes that's fine. We need embargo lift by 08:45 UTC so press can queue syndication.
Julie Park: Design deadline: hero + localized screenshots by EOD tomorrow. Mike, will the partner assets be in the usual drive location?
Mike Chen: Uploading assets to https://drive.redwood.co/marketplace/partners/cloudscale/ by 18:00 PT today.
Tom Reilly: Ops outline (condensed):
```
- 07:30 UTC: infra preflight (certs, DB migrations check)
- 08:00 UTC: internal huddle (10m)
- 08:30 UTC: reduce DNS TTL + CDN prewarm
- 08:45 UTC: embargo lift & PR distribution
- 09:00 UTC: publish landing + marketplace listing
- 09:05 UTC: basic smoke tests (signup, embed, marketplace API)
- 09:30 UTC: triage if anomalies
```
Sree Nandakumar: SI note  EdgeWorks needs a test tenant and rotated API keys by 07:30 UTC. Tom, confirm provisioning ETA?
Tom Reilly: Confirmed provisioning complete 07:00 UTC. I'll post logs into the runbook doc.
Ana Rivera: Blog ownership? We have draft v3 in HackMD but need partner quote and final headliner.
Julie Park: I'll finalize the blog and pull in Priya for a 2-sentence quote (30-50 words) by EOD PT. Suggested CTA copy: "Try CloudScale on Redwood  Deploy in minutes."
Priya (CloudScale): Quote ack, will send by 17:00 PT. CTA copy looks good.
Mike Chen: Proposed canonical routes: /cloudscale (landing) and /partners/cloudscale (marketplace). Approve?
Ana Rivera: Approve. Tom, ensure GA/UTM template applied and redirect rules in place.
Tom Reilly: Will apply UTM template and add redirect entries. Also will prewarm CDN with a 1-hour rolling fetch prior to publish.
Sree Nandakumar: Rollback steps for runbook (brief):
```
1) Repoint /partners/cloudscale -> hold static page
2) POST /v1/private/listings/{id}/revert
3) Post status to #partners and open incident if >5% failures
```
Mike Chen: Launch-day staffing needed: 2 infra, 1 comms, 1 partner PM from 08:30-10:30 UTC. Volunteers?
Julie Park: I'll take comms 08:30-10:30 UTC.
Tom Reilly: I'll be infra primary 07:30-09:30 UTC, handing off to Sree at 09:30.
Sree Nandakumar: Taking infra secondary 09:30-11:00 UTC.
Ana Rivera: @Mike please add the on-call roster to the calendar invite and update the runbook page: https://handbook.redwood.co/launches/cloudscale-gTM-runbook (include mobile numbers).
Mike Chen: Calendar invite updated and runbook now has phone tree + escalation ladder.
LaunchBot: Reminder scheduled: "Pre-launch health check" 07:20 UTC -> #ops-bridge
Ana Rivera: Any legal/compliance embargo blockers?
Julie Park: Legal cleared embargo wording yesterday. I'll CC legal on publish thread for visibility.
Priya (CloudScale): Partner checklist green except final quote. We'll be monitoring during 08:30-10:30 UTC.
Mike Chen: Action items: Julie finalize blog + partner quote (EOD), Mike update runbook/calendar (today), Tom provision infra + prewarm CDN (day-of morning), Sree add rollback to runbook (today), Priya deliver quote (by 17:00 PT).
Ana Rivera: I'll post final "go/no-go" at 06:00 UTC day-of. If no objections, proceed. :rocket:
